title: Automatic triggering: systematic-debugging on a bug without naming the skill
notes: Planted bug: Term.__getitem__ swaps the slice bounds (Field[a:b] becomes BETWEEN b AND a); .between() is still correct. The prompt does not mention skills. 'skill_systematic_debugging' is a MEASUREMENT (required: false): it records whether the skill was loaded and neither passes nor fails the harness. Task success is the fix (hidden tests + suite).
